text: In the week before Christmas, the ailing millionaire Rudolph Deutsch sends the physicist Lionel Barrett to the Belasco House to [investigate the afterlife|trigger|digging into a mystery]. With him go his wife Ann, the medium Florence Tanner, and Benjamin Fischer, sole survivor of an earlier investigation in [a house where 27 people were once found dead|origin|places with dark pasts]. Séances bring clattering objects and ectoplasm, Ann falls into strange trances, and Barrett readies [a machine to drain the house's energy|images|household objects and machines] while [something in the rooms|threat|evil places] fights back.
